findings.desc: The command catalog advertises Alias: lattice done prepare for done_prepare, but NESTED_SPACE_ALIASES only maps `done closure`; `normalizeNestedSpaceAlias(["done","prepare","{}"])` returns matched:false while `done closure` maps correctly. Users following the documented alias hit command `done` instead of done_prepare.
findings.resolvedReason: Added done prepare -> done_prepare mapping in alias-normalizer; command-catalog-smoke passed after fix.

findings.desc: done_prepare is registered in command-catalog/COMMAND_POLICIES/DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS, but the CLI-engine compatibility MAIN_TOOLS marker was not updated. `node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` fails with `lifecycle policy entry not present in MAIN_TOOLS: done_prepare` plus DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS drift for every phase, so the process-fact/command policy contract is broken.

Dry-run no-mutation coverage is overclaimed. CHK-005:adversarial:2 requires dryRun=true against a scenario that would otherwise merge main, refresh stale evidence, or write metadata, but the smoke at packages/main/src/tasks/done-prepare-smoke.ts:402 builds an already-ready repo with no main divergence, no stale evidence, and no build output path. It only proves git status is unchanged in a mostly no-op dryRun path. A regression that accidentally merges main or refreshes stale evidence under dryRun would not be exercised by this case. Add a dryRun smoke with main ahead and/or stale safe-refresh evidence, assert the same files/evidence/version/build state before and after, and assert the output reports the skipped planned mutation.

done_prepare bypasses the required commit-required stop for prepare-generated metadata. In packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:610 it delegates safe stale verification evidence refresh to createChecklistHandlers(ctx).verification_evidence_refresh_stale({ storyId }). That handler rewrites checklist evidence and then calls autoCommitStoryMetadata at packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:1039-1045, whose implementation stages and commits the story metadata at packages/main/src/core/auto-commit-metadata.ts:200-218. As a result, done_prepare can produce and auto-commit metadata, then see a clean tree and print PASS, instead of blocking at cleanTree with exact files as required by docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md:293-308 and acceptance lines 604-605. The concept contract says the first implementation must not auto-commit prepare-generated metadata; callers need the explicit commit-required stop before DONE.
